programme.desc: Espacio que analiza los temas más relevantes de la actualidad futbolística y de otros deportes. Además, "El Desmarque de Cuatro" ofrece imágenes curiosas del universo deportivo.

programme.title: El tiempo
programme.desc: Espacio informativo que ofrece la previsión meteorológica.

programme.title: Cuarto Milenio
programme.desc: Iker Jiménez capitanea un grupo de especialistas y expertos que acerca el mundo del misterio y de lo inédito a los espectadores. El programa aborda, además, temas clásicos de la parapsicología, entre ellos ovnis, fantasmas y psicofonías.

programme.title: Cuarto Milenio

programme.title: El chiringuito
programme.desc: El programa líder de la noche deportiva en televisión aterriza en Mediaset manteniendo intactas las señas de identidad que lo han llevado hasta lo más alto: el entretenimiento, la información en directo, las exclusivas y la última hora del fútbol y del deporte en general.

programme.title: Sportium game show
programme.desc: Espacio conducido por Sofía Del Prado y con la colaboración de Gemma Manzanero, Marc Vila y Juanma Pastor, en el que se repasan las mejores apuestas y cuotas deportivas, y donde se descubren toda la variedad de juegos de casino, slots y poker de Sportium.

programme.title: En el punto de mira
programme.desc: Programa de investigación donde reporteros revelan la cara oculta de la actualidad usando tecnología avanzada como drones y cámaras ocultas.

programme.title: Puro Cuatro
programme.desc: La música que suena en los programas y autopromociones de la cadena es la protagonista de este programa de Cuatro. El espacio es un escaparate de las últimas tendencias del pop, rock, «hip hop» y electrónica, así como una lanzadera para dar a conocer a nuevos artistas.

programme.title: Love Shopping TV

programme.title: ¡Toma Salami!
programme.desc: Espacio vespertino que ofrece en tira diaria los momentos más destacados de los 30 años de historia de Mediaset España. Se recuperan momentos míticos y estará narrado por Javier Capitán.

programme.desc: El artista Rodrigo Cuevas es asturiano como su bisabuelo Salvador. Pero sabe muy poco de él. programme.title: Forjado a fuego
programme.desc: Cuatro herreros especializados compiten en la fabricación de espadas y todo tipo de armas. Forjado a Fuego convierte la artesanía, la leyenda y la emoción de la creación de armas en una batalla de ingenio a contrarreloj. Los concursantes compiten en una serie de desafíos eliminatorios utilizando el 'almacén' de herramientas de que disponen; cada reto se centra en la fabricación de un arma que será valorada por un reconocido grupo de expertos. La carrera para crear el arma elegida en cada episodio se convierte en un viaje por la historia de la armería con limitaciones de tiempo y un final explosivo. La serie presenta nuevas armas y concursantes, así como asombrosas pruebas a las que van a someter sus creaciones.

programme.title: ¿Quién da más?
programme.desc: Cuando el alquiler no se paga en un depósito de almacenamiento durante tres meses en California, un subastador vende el contenido como un solo lote de artículos. El programa sigue a los compradores profesionales que adquieren los contenidos basándose sólo en una inspección de cinco minutos de lo que pueden ver desde la puerta cuando se abre. El objetivo es obtener beneficios sobre la mercancía.

programme.title: Servicio Secreto by Chicote
programme.desc: En Servicio secreto by Chicote, el chef Alberto Chicote se infiltra en restaurantes en crisis con la ayuda de cámaras ocultas y un confidente interno, para descubrir qué está fallando realmente en su día a día. Sin que los dueños lo sepan, todo queda grabado sin filtros mientras creen participar en un programa de renovación.

programme.title: Pesadilla en el infierno con Gordon Ramsey
programme.desc: El chef británico se lanza a la carretera para recorrer Estados Unidos con una misión: reflotar restaurantes fallidos con la ayuda de 'Hell on wheels', su espectacular camión-cocina de alta tecnología de 21 metros. Aunque el reto se endurece para Ramsay: dentro del objetivo de comprometerse a llevarlos a la salvación, solo dispondrá de únicamente 24 horas.Para conocer qué problemas tiene el local, previamente el presentador ya ha acudido de incógnito junto a miembros de su equipo. Tras un día de entrenamiento, consejos y renovaciones, cada entrega culminará con el relanzamiento del restaurante y un menú renovado trabajado por el propio Ramsay.

programme.title: Pesadilla en la cocina (USA)
programme.desc: El carismático, controvertido y reconocido internacionalmente chef escocés, Gordon Ramsay, visita un negocio hostelero inmerso en serios problemas para darles solución. Sus métodos no son los más ortodoxos, y a veces ni siquiera los más educados, pero su experiencia le avala como el chef más famoso de la historia de la cocina inglesa.

programme.title: Batalla de restaurantes
programme.desc: Alberto Chicote recorre todo el país para descubrir los mejores restaurantes y comprobar cómo sus propietarios lo dan todos por defender el negocio de su vida. 4 restaurantes de una misma ciudad y especialidad se baten en duelo, valorándose entre ellos, para ganar 10.000€.

programme.title: Pesadilla en la cocina
programme.desc: Alberto Chicote mantiene los ingredientes básicos de la carta tradicional de 'Pesadilla en la cocina': tesón ante los nuevos retos, constancia a pesar de las difíciles situaciones de los restaurantes, exigencia ante los disparates culinarios de muchos cocineros y grandes dosis de paciencia. Todo aderezado con el carácter luchador, firme y perseverante de Chicote.

programme.title: La sirena de las aguas verdes
programme.desc: AÑO: 1955 TÍTULO ORIGINAL: Underwater! DURACIÓN: 99 min. PAÍS: Estados Unidos DIRECCIÓN: John Sturges REPARTO: Jane Russell, Gilbert Roland, Richard Egan, Lori Nelson, Ric Roman SINOPSIS: Dominic Quesada y Johnny Gray son dos buceadores que descubren en aguas del Caribe un galeón español del siglo XVII hundido con un gran tesoro en su interior. programme.title: La pradera sin ley
programme.desc: Dempsey es un vaquero solitario que entra a trabajar en el rancho Triángulo, propiedad de una ambiciosa ganadera. Esta comienza a expoliar de sus pastos a los pequeños rancheros que responden vallando sus campos con alambre de espino. Dempsey se ve enfrentado entre sus ansias de libertad, que le impulsan a rechazar el sistema de cercas y su sentido de la justicia, que le guía hacia el bando de los pequeños rancheros.Un wéstern que toca uno de los temas clásicos del género (las guerras entre granjeros y ganaderos), pero que, gracias a unas acertadas variaciones en el guión y a unas dosis de acción que aumentan conforme la trama llega a su clímax, consigue mantener intacto su interés. Excelente trabajo del gran cineasta King Vidor (''El gran desfile'', ''Y el mundo marcha''), quien, para su antepenúltima película, contó con un inspiradísimo Kirk Douglas, en un papel hecho a su medida. Su compañera de aventuras fue Jeanne Crain, con quien ya había coincidido en 1949 en el rodaje de ''Carta a tres esposas'', de Joseph L. Mankiewicz.

programme.title: El retorno de Clint el solitario
programme.desc: Clint, un pistolero en busca y captura, regresa a casa. Su esposa accede a que se quede con la condición de que se encargue del rancho y las tierras y le hace prometer que no volverá a usar las armas.Tras el éxito de ''Clint, el solitario'', uno de los directores más prolíficos del wéstern español, Alfonso Balcázar, no dudó en hacer una segunda parte, con él en la dirección y de nuevo con el rol de Clint Harrison encomendado a George Martin. A pesar de tener un nombre artístico internacional, realmente se llamaba Francisco Martínez Celeiro, un barcelonés muy conocido en el género del Oeste europeo por cintas como ''Los tres superhombres en el Oeste''.En esta ocasión, le secunda Klaus Kinski, el actor fetiche de Werner Herzog en ''Aguirre, la ira de dios'', ''Nosferatu, el vampiro'', entre otras. El resultado, como acostumbraba a pasar con este tipo de propuestas, tuvo un éxito más que aceptable en taquilla.

programme.title: La fuga de Eddie Macon
programme.desc: En Texas, un hombre condenado injustamente se escapa de la cárcel, emprendiendo una larga odisea para reunirse con su familia en México. Pero pisándoles los talones, siempre tendrá a un duro e incansable policía que le persigue. Jeff Kanew, un director estadounidense conocido por su comedia ''La revancha de los novatos'', también cultivó otros géneros como la acción. Mezclando adrenalina con un toque dramático, el realizador quiso contar con un actor de lo más carismático: un ya veterano Kirk Douglas. Kanew gozó tanto con el legendario intérprete, que volvería a trabajar con el en ''Otra ciudad, otra ley'' y en el documental ''Kirk Douglas: Before I Forget''. En esta ocasión, el mítico protagonista de ''Espartaco'', ''Senderos de gloria'' o ''El gran carnaval'', compartió pantalla con John Schneider (''Smallville''), quien en aquel entonces gozaba de gran popularidad gracias a la serie ''Los Dukes de Hazzard''. La tercera en discordia fue Lee Purcell, una actriz que había colaborado en largometrajes como ''Mr. Majestyk'' o ''La chica del valle''.

programme.title: Live: Good Morning Football
programme.desc: NFL Network enters the morning show fray with a three-hour live presentation. Each day, "Good Morning Football" brings viewers up-to-the-minute breaking NFL news and local NFL stories on a national platform. The show features a combination of headline-making interviews and a discussion of a wide array of issues in the areas of sports, news and entertainment. By booking celebrity guests and opinionated national and local journalists -- and taking advantage of a close collaboration with all 32 NFL franchises -- "Good Morning Football" breaks out within and well beyond its time period.

programme.title: Double Whammy
programme.desc: Ray Pluto (Denis Leary) has many problems. He is satirized in the tabloids as the "loser cop." His partner (Steve Buscemi) is starting to seem suspiciously attracted to him. A pair of screenwriters (Donald Faison, Keith Nobbs) across the hall keep bugging him for help. The superintendent of his building (Luis Guzmán) is stabbed by hoodlums hired by his own rebellious daughter (Melonie Diaz). To top it off, a sexually aggressive chiropractor (Elizabeth Hurley) may just be Ray's undoing.

programme.title: Chappaquiddick
programme.desc: On July 18, 1969, Sen. Ted Kennedy drives his car off of a bridge on Massachusetts' Chappaquiddick Island. The accident results in the death of passenger Mary Jo Kopechne, a 28-year-old campaign strategist who worked for Kennedy. The ongoing investigation into the mysterious and scandalous events forever alters Kennedy's political legacy -- and ultimately changes the course of presidential history.

programme.title: Jericho
programme.desc: Jericho (Mark Valley) wakes up with no memory, but it's apparent that he's quite skilled with a gun. He is befriended by Joshua (Leon Coffee), who appears to be his polar opposite: He's a black man and true believer in the Lord, whereas Jericho is white and doubtful of everything, especially himself. Side by side, they attempt to piece together the amnesiac's past, which may or may not have something to do with a robbery, and either way is somehow connected to a town that's also called Jericho.

programme.title: Prairie Badmen
programme.desc: Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) and his pal, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are riding west when they meet a traveling medicine show run by a doctor and his teenage son. Billy discovers that the doctor has a map showing the location of a stash of gold stolen from a local stagecoach company. Billy and the doctor favor returning the gold to its owners, while the son wants to keep it for themselves. When the teen runs off with the map and finds himself chased by outlaws, Billy rides out to save him.

programme.title: Border Feud
programme.desc: A feud has broken out over control of a Nevada gold mine, and Sheriff Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) realizes that he needs a steady hand by his side. Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. Beckoned by Fuzzy, Cheyenne arrives just as local beauty Carol Condon (Gloria Marlen) is taken captive by one of the warring parties. Cheyenne and Fuzzy will have to act fast in order to free her and defuse the tension.

programme.title: Susanna Pass
programme.desc: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps.

programme.title: Paradise Canyon
programme.desc: Rough-and-tumble federal agent John Wyatt (John Wayne) receives an unusual undercover assignment: He must infiltrate the ranks of an Arizona-based medicine show. Wyatt's boss suspects the show's shifty-eyed proprietor, ex-convict Dr. Carter (Earle Hodgins), of running a massive counterfeiting operation. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns).

programme.title: Man From Oklahoma
programme.desc: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) and his partner (George "Gabby" Hayes) help a woman (Dale Evans) in distress.

programme.title: Rimfire
programme.desc: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost.

programme.title: Oath of Vengeance
programme.desc: Cowhands Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) and Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) open a general store together in a town embroiled in a battle between ranchers and farmers. Cattleman Dale Kirby (Mady Lawrence) believes the farmers have been stealing cattle, forcing him to borrow from crooked lender Steve Kinney (Jack Ingram). In truth, however, it is Kinney himself who is behind the cattle thefts. When Billy attempts to mediate, he and Fuzzy find themselves threatened by Kinney.

programme.title: After Dark, My Sweet
programme.desc: After escaping from a mental hospital, drifting ex-boxer Kid Collie (Jason Patric) meets an alcoholic widow, Fay (Rachel Ward), who entices him into performing maintenance work at her estate. When crooked Uncle Bud (Bruce Dern) joins the two, Fay's darker side begins to appear. Bud and Fay concoct a scheme to kidnap the son of a local wealthy family and have Collie carry out the dirty work, to which the troubled ex-boxer agrees, but he soon has second thoughts.

programme.title: Live!
programme.desc: Documentarian Rex (David Krumholtz) follows ruthless reality television producer Katy Courbet (Eva Mendes), a woman who will stop at nothing to revive the American Broadcasting Network's failing ratings -- and forward her own career. To the dismay of the government, Courbet approves a reality show that will become network television's first foray into snuff. In the first episode, contestants engage in a deadly game of Russian roulette for the chance at a multi-million-dollar cash prize.

But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. programme.title: The Mini-Skirt Mob
programme.desc: The leader (Diane McBain) of a motorcycle gang harasses her ex-boyfriend and his bride (Sherry Jackson) on their highway honeymoon.

programme.title: The Savage Seven
programme.desc: A motorcycle gang terrorizes a Native American reservation -- until the gang's leader, Kisum (Adam Roarke), falls for waitress Marcia Little Hawk (Joanna Frank). The two groups soon put aside their differences to team up against crooked Fillmore (Mel Berger), who employs Marcia and her brother, Johnnie (Robert Walker). But Fillmore decides to encourage dissent among them, arranging for the death of a gang member and framing a Native American -- which leads Kisum to plot an attack on the town.

programme.title: Born Losers
programme.desc: A biker gang incites a reign of terror in a California coastal town that culminates in four teenage girls being raped. Vietnam veteran Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) has had enough, however, and takes on the depraved bikers single-handedly. He rescues young Vicky Barrington (Elizabeth James) from their clutches, but then has to contend with not only the thugs, but also the ineffectual and racist local lawmen, who have it out for the half-Native American Billy.

programme.title: The Secret Place
programme.desc: Robbers try to retrieve gems that fell into the hands of a policeman's son.

programme.title: Hell's Belles
programme.desc: When biker Dan (Jeremy Slate) wins a motorcycle race, he wants to sell the bike he receives as a prize and use the cash to buy a ranch. But the bike is stolen by Tony (Michael Walker) and finds its way into the hands of Tampa (Adam Roarke), so Dan goes on a quest for revenge. He tracks down Tampa and his gang and uses a variety of tools to neutralize them, all in pursuit of his prized motorcycle. Dan's worried girlfriend, Cathy (Jocelyn Lane), tags along for the violent ride.

programme.title: The Wild Angels
programme.desc: When Hell's Angels member Loser (Bruce Dern) has his motorcycle swiped, he entreats his gang to help him seek the bike, and revenge. Gang leader Heavenly Blues (Peter Fonda) and his lady, Mike (Nancy Sinatra), succeed in tracking down the thieves, but when a fracas breaks out between the gangs, the cops shoot Loser, putting him in the hospital. The rest of the Angels try to rescue Loser from his sickbed, wreaking havoc in the ward and doing their buddy more harm than good.

programme.title: Angels From Hell
programme.desc: A veteran's homecoming includes acid trips, pot parties and easy women as well as his old role as leader of the pack.

programme.title: The Glory Stompers
programme.desc: Chino (Dennis Hopper) is the head of the Black Souls, a California motorcycle gang at odds with another crew, the Glory Stompers. One day, Chino and his fellow gang members kidnap the head of the Stompers, Darryl (Jody McCrea), and his girlfriend, Chris (Chris Noel). After a heavy beating, the cyclists abandon Darryl but take Chris with them to Mexico. While Chris faces threats of abuse, Darryl teams up with Smiley (Jock Mahoney), an aging ex-Stomper, for a final showdown with the Souls.

Bill tries to convince his son to return to his family, but their reunion is interrupted when another group of natives attacks Tommy's tribe.

programme.title: The Russians Are Coming, the Russians Are Coming
programme.desc: When a Soviet submarine gets stuck on a sandbar off the coast of a New England island, its commander (Theodore Bikel) orders his second-in-command, Lieutenant Rozanov (Alan Arkin), to get them moving again before there is an international incident. Rozanov seeks assistance from the island locals, including the police chief (Brian Keith) and a vacationing television writer (Carl Reiner), while trying to allay their fears of a Communist invasion by claiming he and his crew are Norwegian sailors.

programme.title: War, Italian Style
programme.desc: Two Marines (Fred Clark) fool a German general (Buster Keaton) with documents and disguises in World War II Italy.

programme.title: Matchless
programme.desc: A New York journalist (Patrick O'Neal) plays global spy with an ancient ring that makes him invisible.

programme.title: Romeo and Juliet
programme.desc: In this classic Shakespearean story, long-time adversarial families the Capulets and the Montagues engage in a street brawl, which results in a decree declaring that the next conflict will be punishable by death. But during an opulent masked ball, young Romeo Montague (Laurence Harvey) falls in love with Juliet Capulet (Susan Shentall). With the family feud reignited, Juliet's cousin kills Romeo's friend, Mercutio (Ubaldo Zollo), placing the young lovers in grave danger.

programme.title: Electra
programme.desc: When King Agamemnon returns from battle, he is slain by his wife, Clytemnestra (Aleka Katselli), and her lover. The king's son, Orestis (Giannis Fertis), is sent into exile, and his daughter, Electra (Irene Papas), into mourning. Over the years, Electra's hatred of her mother grows, and she bristles with the desire for vengeance. When she and Orestis are reunited, the siblings hatch a plot for revenge. But can they reconcile their need for justice with the act of matricide?

programme.title: Moulin Rouge
programme.desc: Visually exquisite biopic of Toulouse-Lautrec, the crippled painter whose work perfectly captured the spirit of Bohemian Paris in the naughty 1890s. Portrayed as an embittered loner, he is tormented by his doomed relationships with prostitute Marie Charlet and sympathetic model Myriamme.

Vietnam veteran Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) has had enough, however, and takes on the depraved bikers single-handedly. He rescues young Vicky Barrington (Elizabeth James) from their clutches, but then has to contend with not only the thugs, but also the ineffectual and racist local lawmen, who have it out for the half-Native American Billy.

programme.title: Thunder Road
programme.desc: Unrepentant Tennessee moonshine runner Luke Doolin (Robert Mitchum) makes dangerous high-speed deliveries for his liquor-producing father, Vernon (Trevor Bardette), but won't let his younger brother Robin (James Mitchum) join the family business. Under pressure from both out-of-town gangster Kogan (Jacques Aubuchon), who wants a piece of the local action, and Treasury agent Barrett (Gene Barry), who wants to destroy the moonshine business, Luke fights for his fast-fading way of life.

programme.title: The Organization
programme.desc: When an executive and a night watchman are killed in a San Francisco office building, Lt. Virgil Tibbs is called in to investigate and discovers the watchman was actually killed elsewhere. Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force.

programme.title: Behind the Mask
programme.desc: The Shadow (Kane Richmond) tracks a killer to a clip joint and exposes a city editor's racket.

programme.title: The Mini-Skirt Mob
programme.desc: The leader (Diane McBain) of a motorcycle gang harasses her ex-boyfriend and his bride (Sherry Jackson) on their highway honeymoon.

programme.title: The Big Caper
programme.desc: A crook's (James Gregory) partners (Rory Calhoun, Mary Costa) pose as newlyweds near Camp Pendleton, Calif., to set up a Marine payroll heist.

programme.title: I Want to Live!
programme.desc: This film tells the riveting true story of brazen bad girl Barbara Graham (Susan Hayward, in an Academy Award-winning performance), a perpetual offender who tries to go straight but is sent to death row after being implicated in a murder. When journalist Ed Montgomery (Simon Oakland), whose initial newspaper articles on Barbara's crime played up her recklessness, becomes convinced that she may be innocent, he begins a desperate campaign to save her from the gas chamber.

programme.title: Trapeze
programme.desc: Mike Ribble (Burt Lancaster) is a hard-drinking tent pitcher. His career as a famous trapeze artist ended years ago after attempting a triple somersault gave him a permanent limp. Young acrobat Tino (Tony Curtis) tracks Mike down and asks him to teach him the dangerous stunt. Mike first refuses but is convinced by his ex-lover, Rosa (Katy Jurado). Mike and Tino have a shot at the big time, but the two men are driven apart by the scheming of Lola (Gina Lollobrigida), an Italian trampolinist.

programme.desc: A pair of high-school teenagers from different social standings have a date; when the girl resists the boy he begins to think of her as someone special and thinks they should get married immediately. Both sets of parents disapprove and urge patience.

programme.title: Kings Go Forth
programme.desc: During World War II, in a picturesque town on the French Riviera, U.S. Army Lt. Sam Loggins (Frank Sinatra) and Cpl. Britt Harris (Tony Curtis) both fall for the same local girl, the American-born Monique Blair (Natalie Wood). But when the soldiers learn that Monique and her mother (Leora Dana) had moved to France from the United States to escape discrimination against her parents' interracial marriage, each man must examine his own bigotry and prejudices.

programme.title: Marshal Law
programme.desc: In the wake of a devastating earthquake, a former U.S. marshal (Jimmy Smits) fights thugs terrorizing an isolated Los Angeles community.

programme.title: Warriors Five
programme.desc: An American paratrooper (Jack Palance), aided by group of Italian guerrillas, starts a delaying action against the Germans.

programme.title: The Wild Angels
programme.desc: When Hell's Angels member Loser (Bruce Dern) has his motorcycle swiped, he entreats his gang to help him seek the bike, and revenge. Gang leader Heavenly Blues (Peter Fonda) and his lady, Mike (Nancy Sinatra), succeed in tracking down the thieves, but when a fracas breaks out between the gangs, the cops shoot Loser, putting him in the hospital. The rest of the Angels try to rescue Loser from his sickbed, wreaking havoc in the ward and doing their buddy more harm than good.

programme.title: Four Boys and a Gun
programme.desc: Young toughs will all die in the electric chair unless they tell who killed a policeman during a holdup.

programme.title: Bucktown, U.S.A.
programme.desc: After his brother's death, Duke Johnson (Fred Williamson) travels to a small Southern town to organize his brother's funeral. During his stay, he decides to revive his brother's nightclub business. However, this venture quickly uncovers the thinly veiled racism and corruption that run rampant in the town. Duke and his friend Aretha (Pam Grier) face demands for bribes and violence from the police. With the arrival of Duke's pal Roy (Thalmus Rasulala), the situation only escalates.

programme.title: Friday Foster
programme.desc: On assignment from her editor, photographer Friday Foster (Pam Grier) travels to an airport to capture a few shots of the richest black man in the United States (Thalmus Rasulala). But it turns out Foster isn't the only one taking shots as she witnesses -- and photographs -- an assassination attempt on her subject. With definitive evidence in her possession, she also becomes a target of the assassins. Joining a private eye (Yaphet Kotto), Foster sets out to discover the truth behind the attempt.

programme.title: Sheba, Baby
programme.desc: When the loan business of her father, Andy (Rudy Challenger), is trashed by thugs looking to force a sale, Chicago private investigator Sheba Shayne (Pam Grier) travels back to her hometown of Louisville, Ky., to even the score. Together with old flame Brick Williams (Austin Stoker), she attacks the henchmen of local loan shark Pilot (D'Urville Martin), but a retaliation leaves Andy dead. Blind with rage, Sheba vows to take out Pilot's boss, mob kingpin Shark (Dick Merrifield).

programme.title: Black Mama, White Mama
programme.desc: Lee Daniels (Pam Grier) is a black girl busted for prostitution. Karen Brent (Margaret Markov) is a white girl arrested for her involvement with a local revolutionary group. The two women meet in jail and, despite their mutual animosity, are chained together for transport to a maximum security prison. Their bus is ambushed en route, however, and the pair manages to escape together. Chased by bounty hunters, crooked police and revolutionaries, they struggle to get along and get away.

programme.title: Drum
programme.desc: A slaver (Warren Oates) buys Drum (Ken Norton), a bordello queen's (Silvia Pinal) son, in the 1860s New Orleans.

programme.title: Hollywood Shuffle
programme.desc: Aspiring actor and hot-dog stand employee Bobby Taylor (Robert Townsend) catches the ire of his grandmother (Helen Martin) for auditioning for a role in the regrettably titled exploitation film Jivetime Jimmy's Revenge. When Tinseltown Studios casts Taylor in the title role, he has a series of conflicted dreams satirizing African-American stereotypes in Hollywood, and must reconcile his career goals with his desire to remain a positive role model for his little brother (Craigus R Johnson).

programme.title: Catch the Heat
programme.desc: An agent (Tiana Alexandra) works as an exotic dancer to nab a drug smuggler (Rod Steiger) who hides heroin in breast implants.

programme.title: Article 99
programme.desc: Dr. Richard Sturgess (Ray Liotta) leads a team of compassionate doctors at a veteran's hospital. Along with Drs. Morgan (Kiefer Sutherland), Handleman (Forest Whitaker) and Van Dorn (Lea Thompson), he fights to deliver adequate care to needy veterans in the face of funding cuts and a corrupt administration. To succeed, the staff may have to bend the rules and circumvent the villainous "Article 99," a bureaucratic loophole that prevents veterans from receiving the benefits they deserve.

programme.title: Cotton Comes to Harlem
programme.desc: Harlem's African-American population is being ripped off by the Rev. Deke O'Malley (Calvin Lockhart), who dishonestly claims that small donations will secure parcels of land in Africa. When New York City police officers Gravedigger Jones (Godfrey Cambridge) and Coffin Ed Johnson (Raymond St. Jacques) look into O'Malley's scam, they learn that the cash is being smuggled inside a bale of cotton. But the police, O'Malley and lots of others find themselves scrambling when the money goes missing.

programme.title: Slaughter
programme.desc: After his parents are killed by a car bomb, a former Green Beret named Slaughter (Jim Brown) begins investigating and is shocked to discover they were targets of a Mafia hit. He decides to settle the score on his own and successfully takes out some of the gangsters responsible before being caught by police. Now faced with a murder charge, Slaughter strikes a deal with government officials to have the charges dropped provided he can find and kill another gangster who's since fled to Mexico.

programme.title: Eve of Destruction
programme.desc: An anti-terrorist (Gregory Hines) hunts a walking bomb made by a scientist (Renée Soutendijk) in her own image, with all of her hang-ups.

programme.title: Getting Even
programme.desc: Rival Texas chemical magnates (Edward Albert, Joe Don Baker) hold Dallas hostage over nerve gas stolen from the Soviets.

programme.title: Diary of a Hitman
programme.desc: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck (Lewis Smith) recruits the assassin to kill his wife, Jain (Sherilyn Fenn), along with the couple's baby. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task.

programme.title: Deadly Intent
programme.desc: An adventurer's boss (Maud Adams) and other villains want his widow (Lisa Eilbacher) to lead them to his South American jewels.

programme.title: Diggstown
programme.desc: After being released from a Georgia prison, smooth-talking con man Gabriel Caine (James Woods) teams up with his partner in crime, Fitz (Oliver Platt), and travels to remote Diggstown. Upon arriving, Fitz and Caine bet the wealthiest resident, former boxing manager John Gillon (Bruce Dern), that they know a guy who can beat Diggstown's 10 best fighters in one day. After Caine reels in "Honey" Roy Palmer (Louis Gossett Jr.), an aging boxer and old acquaintance, the grift is on.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Hammer
programme.desc: Hotheaded laborer B.J. Hammer (Fred Williamson) can't go long without ending up in a fight, and, after he comes out on top in a particularly impressive workplace scuffle, word of his brawling skills makes its way to Davis (Bernie Hamilton), a top boxing manager. Hammer is hired by Davis and begins a lucrative career in the ring, only to find out that his new employer wants him to throw a fight and take part in other illicit activities. Hammer reacts to this news violently, and the feud is on.

programme.title: Body and Soul
programme.desc: Leon Johnson (Leon Isaac Kennedy) is a boxer who plans to study medicine, but, with his ailing sister, Kelly (Nikki Swassy), in need of costly care, he decides to earn a living in the ring. His rise is rapid, but Leon's newly extravagant lifestyle threatens his relationship with girlfriend Julie (Jayne Kennedy). As Leon approaches the sport's highest echelons, he faces increasingly tough decisions that test his loyalty to his family and himself.

programme.title: Penitentiary
programme.desc: Hitchhiker Martel "Too Sweet" Gordone gets a lift from prostitute Linda in her van and travels with her to meet her clients. After a fight breaks out with the men, Gordone is knocked unconscious and awakens to find he has been wrongly charged with murder. As a way to protect himself in prison, Gordone starts fighting other inmates. This leads him to discover an underground boxing tournament, with the top prize being a prison release.

programme.title: Penitentiary II
programme.desc: Boxer "Too Sweet" Gordone (Leon Isaac Kennedy) tries keeping his nose clean after being paroled from prison. He could box, but he doesn't want to go back to that life. He works as a deliveryman instead, and starts seeing his old girlfriend, Clarisse (Eugenia Wright). But a psychotic criminal, Half Dead (Ernie Hudson), who was Gordone's enemy in prison, breaks out and kills Clarisse as payback. The murder forces Gordone back into the ring, and he is desperate to get revenge against Half Dead.

programme.desc: An agent (Tiana Alexandra) works as an exotic dancer to nab a drug smuggler (Rod Steiger) who hides heroin in breast implants.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: Savage Sisters
programme.desc: Three women (Gloria Hendry, Cheri Caffaro, Rosanna Ortiz) of three races join the fundraising part of an island revolution.

programme.title: Act of Vengeance
programme.desc: Five women learn martial arts in order to punish a rapist (Peter Brown) who wears a hockey mask.

programme.title: The Glory Guys
programme.desc: Inspired by the Battle of the Little Bighorn, this Western follows a selfish military leader, Gen. While waiting to be sent into combat, two of the men -- Harrod (Tom Tryon) and Rogers (Harve Presnell) -- find themselves in the midst of a love triangle as they both pursue the heart of the beautiful Lou Woddard (Senta Berger).

programme.title: Fort Bowie
programme.desc: A group of Apaches visits a cavalry fort in hopes of laying down their weapons and coming to a peace agreement, but Maj. Wharton (J. Ian Douglas), wanting to make a name for himself, orders his men to massacre them. Meanwhile, Col. Garrett (Kent Taylor) believes his flirtatious wife is sleeping with Capt. Thompson (Ben Johnson), so he tries to get rid of the captain by ordering him to track Victorio (Larry Chance), a notorious Apache warrior who's plotting a large-scale attack on the fort.

programme.title: Davy Crockett, Indian Scout
programme.desc: During the 1840s, a wagon train is headed west with Davy Crockett (George Montgomery), a young man who shares a name with his famous frontiersman uncle, acting as one of the train's Native American scouts. After the passengers narrowly survive a series of ambushes from Native Americans, they come to believe that a spy is on board, helping plot the attacks. Suspicions fall on Davy's innocent partner, Red Hawk (Philip Reed), so he and Davy set out to find the real culprit.

programme.title: The Lone Gun
programme.desc: A marshal (George Montgomery) courts a rancher's sister (Dorothy Malone) and rids a town of rustlers.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: After Bat wins a herd of cattle in a high-stakes card game, a determined rancher makes it difficult for Bat to convert his winnings into cash.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: Bat's former flame calls him to a tent city in Nevada to help save her fiancé from a miscarriage of justice.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: A famous English journalist writing about America's violent West tries to hire a gunslinger to take on Sheriff Clay Hollister so he can write an article about a shootout.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: The great fire of 1881 nearly wiped out the town; as a result, Tombstone is in danger of losing its status as County Seat, leading to a feud.

programme.title: Arizona Whirlwind
programme.desc: The Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson, Bob Steele) shoot it out with a gang of diamond thieves.

programme.title: The Hills Run Red
programme.desc: Confederate soldiers Jerry Brewster (Thomas Hunter) and Ken Seagull (Nando Gazzolo) steal a fortune from the U.S. Army. But, when the partners in crime are ambushed by Union troops, they have to split up; Seagull escapes with the money, and Brewster gets a five-year jail sentence. When Brewster gets out, he discovers that his old crony is responsible for the death of his beloved wife. With the help of a gunslinger named Getz (Dan Duryea), Brewster embarks on a quest for vengeance.

programme.title: Fort Massacre
programme.desc: After his cavalry company is decimated by an Apache attack, Vinson takes charge and tries to lead his remaining men to safety. Unfortunately, his pathological hatred of Native Americans causes him to commit rash acts that put his troops in jeopardy. The enlisted men, especially the rebellious McGurney, question Vinson's leadership and even his morality, but the soldiers must stick together if they wish to make it through Apache lands.

programme.title: Trooper Hook
programme.desc: Wanted for killing a squadron of soldiers, Apache Chief Nanchez (Rudolfo Acosta) is finally captured by Sgt. Clovis Hook (Joel McCrea), who discovers among Nanchez's prisoners Cora Sutliff (Barbara Stanwyck), who had been missing for several years. Sutliff has not only fully integrated into the Apache way of life, she also has a son with Nanchez. Now Hook wants to transport her back to her old way of life, but Nanchez isn't willing to let his son be taken from him.

programme.title: Escort West
programme.desc: In the wake of the Civil War, ex-Confederate soldier Ben Lassiter and his 10-year-old daughter, Abbey, are traveling through Nevada when they cross paths with sisters Martha and Beth Drury. Although Martha is embittered because her fiancé was killed by a Confederate during the war, she is forced to trust Ben when a band of Native Americans tries to attack the sisters, and the soldier offers his protection.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: RC Tuttle starts a campaign to encourage residents to move to Benson because of Tombstone's low water supply and inadequate fire fighting equipment, leading a merchant to set fire to his own store to frame Tuttle.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: A rancher hires a gunfighter to protect him from Jeff Harper, the last member of a family that has waged a feud with the rancher; Harper says he wants a truce with the rancher, but the hired gunfighter's trigger finger itches.

programme.title: Five Guns to Tombstone
programme.desc: Billy (James Brown) is an ex-bandit who has gone clean. His brother Matt (Robert Karnes) is a thug who just busted out of jail. Matt wants his brother to join his gang, but Billy refuses -- that is, until Matt threatens to pin a crime on him. Billy reluctantly rides with the crooks, but a brotherly brawl breaks out and Matt is killed in the scuffle that he instigated, while his adolescent son, Ted (John Wilder), looks on. Unaware of his dad's dastardly side, Ted sics the law on Billy.

programme.title: Gunslinger
programme.desc: When her marshal husband is murdered, Rose Hood (Beverly Garland) slides on his holster and takes his dangerous duty. This riles local brothel madam Erica Page (Allison Hayes), so she employs Cane Miro (John Ireland), a hired gun with an axe to grind, to bring an end to Hood and her brand of justice. When Miro meets Hood, though, he is struck by her strength and beauty. Still, the passion that begins to burn between them will not prevent their inevitable showdown.

programme.title: Gun Brothers
programme.desc: Traveling to what he thinks is his brother's cattle ranch, Chad Santee (Buster Crabbe) meets pretty Rose Fargo (Ann Robinson) when he saves her from the clutches of bad guy Blackjack (James Seay). Together, the two visit Chad's brother, Jubal (Neville Brand), only to learn that he is actually a cattle rustler. They convince him to go straight, antagonizing his partner, Shawnee Jack (Michael Ansara), who feels so betrayed that he comes after all three of them with guns blazing.

programme.title: Gunsight Ridge
programme.desc: Gunslinger Mike Ryan (Joel McCrea) is intent on bringing the dangerous outlaw Velvet Clark (Mark Stevens) to justice. However, Ryan is at a disadvantage, since he doesn't know what the masked robber looks like. Ryan begins to work with the area sheriff and falls for the lawman's pretty daughter, Molly Jones (Joan Weldon). With Clark hiding in plain sight as a piano player, the criminal manages to evade Ryan for a while, but eventually the two adversaries come face-to-face.

programme.title: A Reason to Live, A Reason to Die
programme.desc: After surrendering Fort Holman to the Confederacy without there being a single shot fired, Col. Pembroke (James Coburn) faces public disgrace and a potential court-martial unless he's able to recapture the fort now held by the power-mad Maj. Ward (Telly Savalas). To help him on this mission, Pembroke enlists a ragtag bunch of condemned men who are promised their freedom should they survive. Despite much internal strife, the group gradually comes together in time for the assault.

programme.title: The Return of Sabata
programme.desc: The third in a trilogy about the eponymous lone gunman, this one finds Sabata (Lee Van Cleef) working as a sharpshooter for a circus that's just stopped in an ailing one-horse town. The circus gig is only a front, however: Sabata is actually on the verge of robbing town mayor Joe McIntock (Giampiero Albertini). The mayor's been levying heavy taxes as part of a complex plan to defraud the community, but Sabata manages to rip him off first, only to discover that the money is counterfeit.

programme.title: The Mercenary
programme.desc: Sergei Kowalski, a mercenary only out for himself and a few dollars, joins up with a Mexican peasant-turned-revolutionary, Paco Roman, when the price is right. No longer content to toil for the rich and powerful, Roman plans to bring a new order to Mexico by force with his small ragtag group. While Roman and Kowalski are outnumbered facing the Mexican army, they also have to contend with Curly, a vengeful killer out for blood.

programme.title: Pistol Whipped
programme.desc: Former police officer Matt Conlin hits rock bottom. His drinking is out of control, and he has huge gambling debts. Just as Matt is about to give up all hope, an enigmatic old man approaches him with a proposition. The old man will pay off Matt's gambling debts if he agrees to assassinate the city's top gangsters. Though Matt is reluctant, he accepts the old man's mission, but soon realizes it isn't as straightforward as it seems.

programme.title: Hellcats of the Navy
programme.desc: Captain Casey Abbott (Ronald Reagan) commands an American submarine in the Pacific during World War II. When a perilous mission to retrieve a new Japanese mine for study goes awry, he's forced to abandon a likable combat diver, Wes Barton (Harry Lauter). Abbott's orders to leave a man behind appear to be justified, but his second in command, Don Landon (Arthur Franz), believes he had ulterior motives: Barton had been competing for the attention of his love interest, Helen (Nancy Davis).

programme.title: The Guns of Fort Petticoat
programme.desc: Texan and U.S. Cavalryman Lt. Frank Hewitt (Audie Murphy) deserts the army after Colorado Union soldiers carry out the deadly Sand Creek reservation massacre, fearing reprisal from the Cheyenne. Crossing into Texas, Franks finds himself labeled a traitor for fighting with the Yankees, and his warnings about possible Indian revenge go unheeded. When a town near a mission, populated mostly by women, is attacked, Frank is appointed their protector and must build an army comprised of townswomen.

programme.title: The Guns of Navarone
programme.desc: In 1943, a small commando team is sent to destroy huge German guns on the Greek Island of Navarone in order to rescue Allied troops trapped on Kheros. Led by British Major Franklin (Anthony Quayle), the team includes American Mallory (Gregory Peck), Greek resistance fighter Stavros (Anthony Quinn) and reluctant explosives expert Miller. Facing impossible odds, the men battle stormy seas and daunting cliffs. When Franklin is injured, Mallory takes command, and personal enmities spill over.

programme.title: The Perfect Storm
programme.desc: Based on a true story, the film tells of the courageous men and women who risk their lives every working day, pitting their fishing boats and rescue vessels against the capricious forces of nature. Their worst fears are realized at sea on Halloween of 1991, when they are confronted by three raging weather fronts which unexpectedly collide to produce the greatest, fiercest storm in modern history -- "The Perfect Storm.".

programme.title: Captain Phillips
programme.desc: In April 2009, the U.S. container ship Maersk Alabama sails toward its destination on a day that seems like any other. Suddenly, Somali pirates race toward the vessel, climb aboard and take everyone hostage. The captain of the ship, Richard Phillips, looks to protect his crew from the hostile invaders, and their leader, Muse. The pirates are after millions of dollars, and Phillips must use his wits to make sure everyone survives and returns home safely.

programme.title: Turner & Hooch
programme.desc: Det. Scott Turner (Tom Hanks) is an uptight, by-the-book police officer who hopes to leave his sleepy California town and work in the big city. programme.title: Ils inventent le Futur
programme.desc: Qu'il s'agisse de douleurs chroniques ou de paraplégie, d'amputations ou de déformations physiques, les handicaps sont loin d'être uniformes et nécessitent généralement des solutions adaptées et personnalisées. Face à des parcours de vie éprouvants et à une grande détresse physique, les chercheurs font preuve au quotidien d'une créativité et d'une persévérance remarquables pour soulager, voire, dans certains cas, traiter ce qui semblait incurable.

programme.desc: Quand Bombardier annonce se lancer dans la fabrication d'un jet d'affaires plus rapide, ses concurrents sont sceptiques et nerveux ; le Québec a pourtant toujours été un terreau fertile en aéronautique.

programme.title: Là pour rester
programme.sub-title: Le jeu Trivial Pursuit et le casse-tête 3D
programme.desc: Dans les années 80, deux Québécois sont derrière l'invention d'un jeu de société reconnu internationalement : Trivial Pursuit ; dix ans plus tard, le casse-tête PUZZ-3D, lui aussi créé par un Québécois, prend d'assaut le marché mondial du casse-tête.

programme.title: La bouffe qui a forgé le monde
programme.desc: Un chocolatier qui peine à joindre les deux bouts et un jeune assistant de théâtre créent le kiosque de confiserie de cinéma tel qu'on le connaît aujourd'hui. Ils lancent également les bonbons de cinéma les plus emblématiques au monde.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Tout sur le menu avec Braun Strowman
programme.desc: Braun Strowman s'attaque à Détroit et dévore les plats les plus énormes et satisfaisants de la Motor City, accompagné de l'humoriste Bert Kreischer; deux personnalités hors du commun se télescopent dans de grands plats et éclats de rire au cours d'une journée qui capture tous les atouts intenses et réconfortants de la culture culinaire de Détroit; les plats sont énormes, les histoires encore plus, et Braun et Bert forment l'équipe parfaite pour l'un des épisodes les plus amusants de la saison.

programme.title: Steak, blé d'Inde, patates
programme.sub-title: Le fast-food à la sauce québécoise
programme.desc: La restauration rapide québécoise est passée d'une cuisine de cantine et de bord de rue à une gastronomie populaire, revampée par les plus grands chefs et servie ailleurs dans le monde ; chaque région a développé sa signature en restauration rapide.

programme.title: Les jouets qui ont forgé le monde
programme.sub-title: Les maîtres des jeux de réflexion
programme.desc: Avant la Seconde Guerre mondiale, les jeux de société sont pour la plupart simples, mais la paix et la prospérité d'après-guerre révèlent une demande pour des divertissements plus stimulants.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Le lot du diable
programme.desc: Les trois finalistes s'affrontent dans une série de défis pour accéder à l'épreuve ultime ; à la fin, l'un d'eux sera couronné gagnant de la deuxième saison et repartira à la maison avec le grand prix de 100 000 $.

programme.title: Pawn Stars: prêteurs sur gages
programme.desc: Un vendeur fait parvenir à la boutique la pochette originale d'un des plus grands albums de tous les temps ; des billets de monnaie signés par les milliardaires Warren Buffett et Charlie Munger espèrent bien être encaissés à la boutique.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: IneXplicable
programme.desc: Chaque année, des milliers de personnes déclarent avoir observé le ciel et avoir été témoins d'objets volants non identifiés; la grande majorité de ces incidents étranges et troublants se produisent aux mêmes endroits sur Terre.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Incroyable avec Dan Aykroyd
programme.desc: Parmi les personnes les plus courageuses au monde, certaines se sont démarquées en sortant indemnes des situations les plus périlleuses et étranges, voire carrément irréelles; par exemple, un homme a survécu à l'apocalypse et une femme a été impliquée dans trois naufrages; il y a même un chat qui semble tout simplement imbattable, peu importe le combat dans lequel il se retrouve; voici d'incroyables histoires de réussite, de retrouvailles et de survie.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Secrets déclassifiés avec David Duchovny
programme.desc: Quels sont tous ces secrets cachés et inexpliqués ? David Duchovny nous ouvre la porte des bases gouvernementales ultra-secrètes, nous dévoilant quelques-unes des opérations clandestines qui s'y déroulent ; un laboratoire de poison mortel est exploité par un tristement célèbre médecin de l'Union soviétique ; un immense site de missiles nucléaires est enfoui sous la calotte glaciaire du Groenland ; un bunker apocalyptique du gouvernement américain est dissimulé dans une montagne.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Les grandes évasions avec Morgan Freeman
programme.sub-title: Un camp de prisonniers au Laos
programme.desc: Un pilote germano-américain, Dieter Dengler, utilise les compétences de survie acquises dans son enfance pour s'évader d'une prison secrète au Laos, au début de la guerre du Vietnam.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Nos ancêtres les extraterrestres
programme.desc: De terrifiantes rencontres survenues à 40 000 pieds d'altitude ; des récits de pilotes qui maintiennent que des ovnis ont pris le contrôle de leur avion ; d'immenses appareils qui ont disparu dans les airs sans laisser de traces.

rating.system: Dirección General de Radio, Televisión y Cinematografía

programme.title: La malédiction d'Oak Island
programme.desc: L'équipe continue de rechercher activement le tunnel dont on soupçonne l'existence; les éléments découverts sur le lot 5 suggèrent un lien avec le corsaire Sir William Phipps.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Notre guerre
programme.desc: L'arrière-arrière-petite-fille d'un des premiers militaires noirs du Canada est à la recherche d'une relique disparue ; aux Prairies, un tailleur de vêtements spécialisé en pièces et costumes d'époque parvient à décoder les aveux de son grand-père.

programme.title: Les grands mystères de l'Histoire
programme.desc: Lors d'un braquage planifié à la perfection, des voleurs ont dérobé des oeuvres d'art d'une valeur d'un demi-milliard de dollars au musée Gardner de Boston; trois décennies se sont écoulées depuis ce braquage complètement fou.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: La Seconde Guerre mondiale avec Tom Hanks
programme.desc: L'opération Bleue, aussi nommée Fall Blau: l'armée allemande tente de s'emparer des champs pétrolifères soviétiques et de la ville de Stalingrad, s'engageant dans l'une des batailles les plus meurtrières de l'histoire et marquant un tournant majeur sur le front de l'est.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: La Grande Guerre
programme.desc: Après quatre années d'horreurs inimaginables sur le champ de bataille, les Alliés sont épuisés et risquent de perdre face à l'Allemagne.

programme.title: Les mécanos de Rust Valley
programme.desc: Mike ajoute les touches finales à apporter à la restauration d'une camionnette GMC Handi-Van de 1965 ; il donne un coup de main à un employé qui travaille sur une Buick Special de 1938 ; Mike et Avery s'entraînent pour un concours de danse local.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Les mécanos de Rust Valley
programme.desc: Mike se fait plaisir et décide de restaurer sa toute première voiture, une Sunbeam de 1961 ; Avery achète un camion militaire et demande à Mike de l'aider à le déplacer ; Avery confronte Mike en lien avec les résultats financiers du magasin.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Zombie Cars: sauvés de la scrap
programme.desc: Rémi-Pierre ressuscite un véhicule qui ne laisse personne indifférent: le PT Cruiser. Au début des années 2000, un vent de nostalgie souffle sur le monde automobile. C'est le courant néo-rétro, dans lequel des constructeurs ressortent des modèles qu'ils ne font plus depuis des années. Alors que la Beetle et la Mini Cooper se voient donner une deuxième vie, Chrysler décide de pousser la tendance encore plus loin en développant une voiture qui évoque les lignes des voitures des années 30.

programme.title: Transmission impossible
programme.desc: Les frères Gosselin tombent sur un restaurateur qui leur montre son savoir-faire et qu'un véhicule, c'est fait pour rouler même s'il est unique.

programme.title: Transmission impossible
programme.desc: Yanick fait l'achat d'un modèle qui fait l'envie de tous.

programme.title: Transmission impossible
programme.sub-title: Le 50e du Salon de l'auto de Québec
programme.desc: Les frères Gosselin se rendent au 50e anniversaire du Salon de l'auto de Québec avec un bolide qui fait fureur. Yanick cherche par tous les moyens à confirmer si la Camaro Yenko qu'il vient d'acheter est une vraie, ce qui serait un de ses plus grands coups. Une route jusqu'à Pintendre qui vaut le déplacement pour Raymond, qui achète un muscle car classique.

programme.title: Chasseurs de voitures
programme.desc: L'équipe de Matt se rend dans l'ouest pour découvrir des pièces emblématiques de l'époque de la ruée vers l'or noir au Canada.

programme.title: Camionneurs de brousse
programme.desc: Dave et Angela se rendent en Saskatchewan, la province natale de cette dernière, pour transporter une petite maison sur les lieux d'un mariage, en Colombie-Britannique ; de son côté, Craig rentre en Ontario en raison du décès de son père.

programme.title: Les montagnards
programme.desc: Jake passe la nuit dans les montagnes après que sa motoneige est tombée en panne. Paul pose des pièges pour attraper des visons et des martres. Eustace aide un ami à acheter et à monter une scierie ancienne.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Les montagnards
programme.desc: Tom entame le compte à rebours de son 80e anniversaire; Jake et Anika remorquent une motoneige cassée en bas de la montagne, mais tombent sur des traces de pumas et se remettent en chasse; Paul se lance à l'assaut d'une meute de loups; Aron ouvre des pistes après de fortes chutes de neige, tandis que Jen attrape des lapins pour le dîner; Kidd et Harry construisent un bateau de pêche original pour naviguer en eaux troubles.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Les grands mystères de l'Histoire
programme.desc: Le mystère entourant la mort du roi d'Égypte Toutankhamon, l'un des souverains les plus énigmatiques de l'Histoire, perdure plus de 3 000 ans plus tard; impossible de savoir avec certitude ce qui a mis fin à la vie du jeune pharaon; et si les progrès de la science pouvaient nous rapprocher de la réponse? Qui, ou quoi, a tué le roi Toutankhamon?

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: La vie après nous
programme.desc: Dans un monde sans présence humaine, l'eau abandonne sa mission de source de vie pour se transformer en une impitoyable destructrice: villes inondées, barrages rompus et forces ancestrales longtemps contenues enfin libérées. De La Nouvelle-Orléans à Londres, en passant par les pyramides, lorsque les plus grands exploits d'ingénierie de la civilisation s'effondrent, la nature se déchaîne, redessinant le destin de la Terre dans un tourbillon d'inondations, de ruines et de renaissance sauvage.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Secrets déclassifiés avec David Duchovny
programme.desc: Oubliez la Lune et les étoiles; les gouvernements les plus puissants au monde ont des objectifs beaucoup plus ambitieux dans leur course à la conquête des moindres recoins du ciel; un accident d'avion en Caroline du Nord a failli déclencher une apocalypse nucléaire; une attaque d'ovnis contre une base de missiles américaine a été gardée secrète pendant des décennies et un audacieux braquage israélien visant à voler un avion de chasse s'est déroulé directement sous le nez de leurs ennemis.

programme.title: Une planète en partage

programme.title: Une planète en partage

programme.title: Les Pierrafeu
programme.desc: Les Pierrafeu étaient la famille moderne de l'âge de la Pierre. Résidant dans la ville Saint-Granit, Fred Caillou n'était pas satisfait de son travail à la carrière, mais revenait à la maison auprès de sa charmante épouse Wilma et, enfin de sa fille Agathe. Fred, un grand amateur de golf et de quilles aimait aussi taquiner son voisin Arthur Laroche, tandis que la femme coquine d'Arthur, Bertha était la meilleure amie de Wilma. Au cours de l'émission, Barney et Betty ont adopté un fils anormalement fort, Bamm-Bamm, qui allait devenir plus tard ami avec Agathe. Les Pierrafeu, fortement inspiré par "The Honeymooners" ont convaincu une génération d'enfants que dinosaures et humains ont occupé la planète en même temps.

programme.title: Michel Barrette: L'humour de ma vie

C'est un rendez-vous historique avec un véritable vétéran de l'humour qui replonge dans ses anecdotes plus rocambolesques les unes que les autres. On revit avec nostalgie les décennies passées en laissant Michel raconter ses merveilleuses histoires.

En percutant de plein fouet un convoi chargé de produits toxiques, elle provoque une violente explosion. Les quelques survivants de cet enfer vont tenter de retrouver l'air libre.

programme.title: Selma
programme.desc: Although the Civil Rights Act of 1964 legally desegregated the South, discrimination was still rampant in certain areas, making it very difficult for Blacks to register to vote. In 1965, an Alabama city became the battleground in the fight for suffrage. Despite violent opposition, Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. (David Oyelowo) and his followers pressed forward on an epic march from Selma to Montgomery, and their efforts culminated with President Lyndon Johnson signing the Voting Rights Act of 1965.

Quickly, father and son find themselves on opposite sides of an increasingly dangerous conflict, made worse by the interference of South Africa's Special Branch.

programme.title: El fútbol según Raúl
programme.desc: En tiempos de confinamiento, Raúl, encerrado en su casa, echa la vista atrás para recordar todas aquellas historias que ha contado a lo largo de su trayecto profesional en las pantallas de Movistar +. Tras revisar fotos, vídeos y recuerdos, decide llamar a buena parte de aquellos protagonistas y amigos que ha ido conociendo en el camino para saber de su nueva realidad a causa del coronavirus. Un viaje de Wuhan a Soria, pasando por Chile o Japón en el cual Raúl, una vez levantado el confinamiento, muestra la cara más trágica del virus, descubre héroes anónimos y retrata el estado del fútbol profesional y amateur en una época sin fútbol.

programme.title: 90 años de LaLiga
programme.desc: Jabo Irureta es, después del fallecido Luis Aragonés, el técnico con más partidos dirigidos en Primera División. Desde 1984 hasta 2017 entrenó a Logroñés, Oviedo, Racing, Athletic Club, Real Sociedad, Celta de Vigo, Deportivo de La Coruña, Betis y Zaragoza para un total de 612 encuentros disputados. Irureta logró éxitos como jugador en el Atlético de Madrid y en el Athletic Club y como entrenador entró en la historia viva del Deportivo con la consecución del título de Liga en la temporada 1999-2000 y el trofeo de la Copa del Rey en el año 2002, partido ya conocido históricamente como el Centenariazo. Además ganó dos Supercopas de España con el conjunto gallego.

programme.desc: Pocos jugadores trajeron tanta alegría al futbol español como Ronaldinho tras fichar por el FC Barcelona. Sólo una cosa llamó más la atención que su extraordinaria clase. La rapidez con la que llegó su declive.

programme.title: Universo Valdano
programme.desc: Marcelino en Universo Valdano: 'Me llamó un periodista y me dijo que me iban a destituir como técnico del Valencia' Un técnico diferente, pasional y que no esconde sus sentimientos. Era el momento de charlar tranquilamente con Marcelino García Toral a pocos días de disputar la final de la Copa del Rey ante la Real Sociedad. Marcelino habla sin tapujos de sus inicios como entrenador, de su estancia y salida del Valencia o de su llegada al Athletic y los primeros triunfos con los leones.

programme.title: El fútbol según Raúl
programme.desc: Se suele decir que solo nos acordamos del campeón, que nadie recuerda al subcampeón. Pero hay equipos que por su trayectoria y su forma de caer han quedado para la historia a pesar de no levantar el trofeo. Es el caso del Espanyol en la UEFA de 1988, que perdió a penaltis frente al Bayer Leverkusen, y del Alavés en la UEFA del 2001, que fue derrotado 5-4 por el Liverpool con un gol de oro en propia portería. Raúl nos cuenta la historia de aquellos dos equipos modestos que, contra todo pronóstico, se plantaron en su primera final europea eliminando a los grandes de Europa. Dos gestas inolvidables grabadas a fuego en el corazón de sus aficionados.

programme.title: El fútbol según Raúl
programme.desc: Raúl Ruiz rememora los años dorados, el lustro dorado del Valencia, que arranca con el golazo de Mendieta en la final de Copa 98-99 y la consecución de aquel título y termina en 2004 con el doblete Liga-UEFA con Benítez, su marcha y la Supercopa de Europa de Ranieri, el último título de aquella época dorada en la cual el club ché llegó a disputar dos finales de Champions (ahora se cumplen 20 años de la segunda final) y fue nombrado el mejor equipo del mundo. El hilo conductor del programa es Cañizares y su finca.

programme.title: 90 años de historias
programme.desc: Argentina es el país que más jugadores extranjeros ha aportado a LaLiga en sus 90 años de historia hasta convertirse en la otra inagotable cantera de nuestros clubes. La idiosincrasia y las específicas condiciones de los futbolistas argentinos han asegurado un alto rendimiento a través de los tiempos. Su profesionalidad y su talento mezclado con un gen ganador eran y es una garantía. Jorge Valdano es uno de sus mejores exponentes por su continuidad en el tiempo, pero no hay que olvidar que desde el otro lado del Atlántico llegó entre otros el mismísimo Diego Armando Maradona. Valdano llegó a LaLiga en 1975 para jugar en el Deportivo Alavés. Debutó en Primera con el Zaragoza pero fue en el Real Madrid donde completó su exitosa carrera. Triunfó como jugador y entrenador para completar el círculo como director deportivo.

programme.title: 90 años de historias
programme.desc: Lionel Andrés Messi Cuccittini conocido como Leo Messi, está considerado actualmente como el mejor jugador del mundo y uno de los mejores de todos los tiempos. Es el primer futbolista en la historia que ha ganado, entre otras distinciones, cinco veces el Balón de Oro, los cuatro primeros de forma consecutiva y cinco Botas de Oro. Desde que llegó a los 13 años a la disciplina del F.C. Barcelona no ha parado de progresar y de exhibir su talento jornada tras jornada en el Campeonato pulverizando todos los récords que se cruzan en su camino. Leo Messi es una leyenda viva y en activo que, con tan solo 31 años, ya es el máximo goleador histórico de LaLiga superando a mitos como Cristiano Ronaldo, Telmo Zarra, Hugo Sánchez o Raúl González Blanco.

programme.title: اسمي ملك
programme.desc: تدور أحداث المسلسل حول ملك التي تحاول بناء حياة جديدة مع عائلتها، كما تجاهد من أجل البقاء مع أطفالها الثلاثة. Gaziantep-born Melek is married and has three kids. Her life is turned upside down when her spouse leaves her alone and takes the kids with him.(n)

programme.title: Forbidden Apple
programme.desc: يسلط مسلسل (التفاحة المحرمة) الضوء ضمن أحداثه على عالم رجال الأعمال والثراء الفاحش، والصراع الذي يصنعه الحب من جانب، وسيطرة المال على البشر من جانب آخر. The events highlight the world of businessmen and extreme wealth, the conflict created by love on the one hand, and the control of money over people on the other.(n)

programme.title: بهو الست لميا
programme.desc: في إطار كوميدي، تتمحور الأحداث حول شخصية الست لميا ومساعدها أبو شادي، والفندق الذي تديره، حيث يجمع شخصيات متنوعة من خلفيات اجتماعية وثقافية مختلفة. تنشأ بينهم سلسلة من المفارقات اليومية والمواقف الطريفة المشوقة، والتي تعكس تفاصيل الحياة اليومية بأسلوب ساخر ومرح. The story revolves around Lamia, her assistant Abu Shadi, and the hotel she manages—a place that brings together a diverse group of characters from various social and cultural backgrounds. A series of daily complications and amusing situations unfold among them, reflecting the intricacies of everyday life.(n)

programme.title: نهاركم سعيد
programme.desc: برنامج صباحي يومي، يهتم بمناقشة آخر المستجدات على الساحة السياسية، من خلال إستضافة المحليين السياسيين، لمناقشة القضايا التي تهم الرأي العام في لبنان. كان البرنامج عند انطلاقته بعام 1996 يتناول الأحداث السياسية بفقرة صغيرة مدتها نصف ساعة وبقية فترة البرنامج كانت حول أمور ثقافية ومنوعة. A regular morning program that hosts local politicians to talk about subjects that are important to the people in Lebanon and to debate the latest events in the political scene. When it was launched in 1996, the program dealt with political events in a small segment lasting half an hour, and the rest of the program period was about cultural and other matters.(n)

programme.title: حدوتة حب
programme.desc: في إطار درامي تدور الأحداث حول أربع قصص (الشهر السابع، طفلي المتوحد، شهر عسل، الهاجس) يجمع بينهما دافع الانتقام والخيانة. A drama that covers four stories (the Seventh Month, My Autistic Child, Honeymoon, and Obsession), all of which are connected by the theme of infidelity and revenge.(n)

programme.title: حدوتة حب
programme.desc: في إطار درامي تدور الأحداث حول أربع قصص (الشهر السابع، طفلي المتوحد، شهر عسل، الهاجس) يجمع بينهما دافع الانتقام والخيانة. A drama that covers four stories (the Seventh Month, My Autistic Child, Honeymoon, and Obsession), all of which are connected by the theme of infidelity and revenge.(n)

programme.title: لولا الحب
programme.desc: تدور أحداث المسلسل حول الفتاة مسا (نادين الراسي) التي تعمل وسط مجال إعلامي كبير وتستغل تلك الوظيفة في تسليط الضوء على مجموعة من القضايا والمشاكل الهامة في المجتمع متحدية العديد من الشخصيات ذو السلطة والنفوذ.. في ذات الوقت تحاول اتخاذ قرار بشأن علاقتها غير الشرعية وحملها. The series revolves around Missa, who works in a large media field and sheds light on a range of important issues and problems in society in defiance of many figures with power and influence, while she tries to decide on her affair and pregnancy.

programme.title: علاقات خاصة
programme.desc: يجسد كل زوجين قصة درامية تتشابك أحداثها بشكل أو بأخر مع العلاقات الأخرى بدءًا من «جو» رجل الأعمال المتزوج من «ياسمين» التي تنتمي لبيئة فقيرة ليصنع منها نجمة غناء، وترتبط حياة «جو وياسمين» بـ «حسام» المتزوج من «فرح»، بالرغم من رفض أهلها لهذا الزواج بسبب فارق السن، أما «جهاد» فيقع ضحية إنتقام مزدوج من أخته «رنا» و«إياد» حبيب زوجته المستقبلية «لامار»، أمّا «تيم» فيحب «مايا» رغم اختلاف الديانة. The events of each couple's story are intertwined with other relationships, starting with Jo, a businessman married to Yasmin, who becomes a singing star. Hossam who is married to Farah. While Jehad is the victim of double revenge from his sister Rana and Eiad. As for Tayem, he's in love with Maya despite having a different religion.

programme.title: دورة جونية جبيل
programme.desc: تدور الأحداث في إطار كوميدي متصل منفصل حول سائق أتوبيس يعمل على خط “دورة -جونية-جبيل” والذي يتعرض بسبب ظروف عمله لأحداث كثيرة، منها كوميدية ومنها رومانسية. In a series of separate episodes, a bus driver on the Daoura-Jounieh-Byblos line is exposed to many events, including comedic and romantic ones.

programme.title: بيروت 303
programme.desc: تتفجر طائرة بيروت 303 فوق شاطئ لبنان، فتحول حياة القلة من الناجين إلى رحلة بحث عن الحقيقة، ضمن إطار غامض ومليء بالشك. The Beirut 303 plane explodes over the coast of Lebanon, turning the life of the few survivors into a truth-searching journey.(n)

programme.title: أولاد الراعي
programme.desc: من نقطة الصفر وجذور بسيطة، ينطلق ثلاثة أشقاء في رحلة كفاح مريرة لبناء إمبراطورية تجارية تهز عالم المال. ومع تضخم الثروة والنفوذ، يتحول النجاح إلى اختبار قاسٍ لروابط الدم؛ حيث تتشابك المصالح وتنفجر صراعات السلطة والولاء بينهم. يضعهم العمل أمام خيارات مصيرية تهدد الكيان الذي بنوه معاً، كاشفاً كيف يمكن للمال أن يغير القلوب ويقلب الأشقاء إلى خصوم في ساحة معركة لا ترحم. From scratch, three brothers embark on a bitter struggle to build a business empire. As wealth grows, success turns into a severe test of blood ties, where interests intertwine and power and loyalty struggles clash between them. The brothers are faced with fateful choices that threaten the entity they built together, revealing how money can turn siblings into opponents on a merciless battlefield.(n)

programme.title: The Best Thing
programme.desc: تدور الأحداث حول (شين شيفان)، مديرة فندق مهووسة بالعمل، تلتقي بالطبيب الهادئ (خه سو يه) أثناء بحثها عن علاج. ورغم أن علاقتهما تبدأ طبيعية، فإن الصدفة تجمعهما كجيران، فتتطور بينهما مشاعر حب. The events revolve around Shen Xifan, a workaholic hotel manager, who meets the quiet doctor He Su Ye while searching for a cure. Although their relationship begins professionally, coincidence brings them together as neighbors, and feelings of love develop between them.(n)

programme.title: Barbaros: Sword of the Mediterranean
programme.desc: يحكي المسلسل قصة حياة البحار خير الدين بربروس، الذي صنع بطولات لا تنسى للإمبراطورية العثمانية في عهد السلطان سليم الأول، والذي ضمن السيادة العثمانية في البحر الأبيض المتوسط، وكان من أكبر مؤيدي خير الدين بربروس شقيقه عروج بربروس الذي تمكن من السيطرة على جميع السواحل. The story of the life of the sailor Hayreddin Pasha "Barbarossa" and his unforgettable heroics for the Ottoman Empire during the reign of Sultan Selim I, which guaranteed Ottoman sovereignty in the Mediterranean. One of Barbarossa's biggest supporters was his brother Oruc, who managed to control all the coasts.

programme.title: نبض البلد
programme.desc: برنامج سياسي يتناول العديد من القضايا المحلية والعربية والعالمية، يستضيف متخصصين ويعرض تقارير ميدانية ويتواصل مع الجمهور من خلال التعليقات عبر مواقع التواصل الاجتماعي ويطرحها على الضيوف خلال الحلقة. A political program that addresses many local, Arab, and international issues. programme.title: بخمس أرواح
programme.desc: بين ليلة وضحاها، يجد "شمس" الملقب بـ "ابن الميتة" نفسه أمام مفارقة قدرية؛ فهو الوريث الوحيد لرجل نافذ، لكن الثروة معلقة بشرط تعجيزي: العثور على أشقائه الأربعة الذين طمس والدهم أثرهم من الوجود. في سباقٍ محموم مع الزمن، يخوض شمس رحلةً محفوفة بالدماء لكشف الهوية، حيث الفشل لا يعني ضياع المال فحسب، بل خسارة حياته أمام طامعين ينتظرون سقوطه. Shams, nicknamed “the dead woman's son,” finds himself the only heir to an influential man, but the fortune is subject to an impossible condition: finding his four siblings, whose existence his father wiped out of records. In a frantic race against time, Shams embarks on a blood-filled journey to uncover his identity, as failure does not only mean losing the money, but also losing his life.

programme.title: رسوم متحركة
programme.desc: السنافر شخصيات خيالية صغيرة الحجم، زرقاء اللون، وتعيش في الغابة، تمثل عائلة السنافر الكثير من الشخصيات مختلفة الطباع، والسنافر كثر. للسنافر عدو كريه هو شرشبيل الشرير وقطه الأحمر المشاكس "هرهور" اللذان يعيشان في القلعة المهجورة. The Smurfs are small, blue-colored creatures living in mushroom houses in an enchanted forest. Their peaceful life is constantly interrupted by the evil wizard Gargamel and his nasty cat Azrael who live in an abandoned castle.

programme.title: خبز وملح
programme.desc: يعالج المسلسل مشكلة السمنة التي باتت ظاهرة سلبية تشغل المجتمعات العربية والقائمين على وسائل الإعلام فيها و يهتم بالصحة العامة ويقدم النصيحة الطبية والمعلومة الصحية للمشاهدين، من خلال عائلة تعاني من مشاكل صحية مختلفة بسبب عاداتهم الغذائية السيئة. The series addresses the problem of obesity, which has become a negative phenomenon that preoccupies Arab societies and the media. It focuses on public health and provides medical advice and health information to viewers, through a family suffering from various health problems due to their poor eating habits.

programme.title: السوق الحرة
programme.desc: تدور الأحداث في أروقة «السوق الحرة» بأحد المطارات الدولية، حيث تتقاطع طرق المسافرين العابرين مع الموظفين، فتحدث بينهم مواقف طريفة ومفارقات كوميدية تعكس تباين الثقافات والشخصيات، وتبدّد رتابة أجواء العمل اليومية. Taking place in an international airport's duty-free zone, where the paths of passing travelers intersect with the staff, leading to funny situations and comic mishaps to unfold between them that reflect the contrast of cultures and personalities, and dissipate the monotony of the daily work atmosphere.

programme.title: النويلاتي
programme.desc: في حارة النوياتي التي تغلي بصراعات السلطة والمال، تنطلق حكاية يمتزج فيها الواقع بالأساطير. يعود الغواص من وراء قضبان سجن وُصف بالمقبرة، عائدا بهوية غامضة ووجه غريب ليخترق الحارة من جديد. لا يسعى الغواص للانتقام من الذين خانوه فحسب، بل يقتفي أثر "كنز مفقود" يُقال إنه محروس بطلسم قديم. وفي ظل هذه الظروف القاسية تتقاطع الدروب مع مكائد تجار الدماء، حيث تصبح الهوية المزيفة هي الدرع الوحيد بمعركة البقاء. In the Al Nwaylati neighborhood unfolds a tale where reality and myth intertwine. Ghawwas comes out of prison, seeking not only revenge against those who betrayed him but also pursues a lost treasure. Amidst these harsh circumstances, his path crosses with the machinations of ruthless profiteers, making his assumed identity his only shield in the battle for survival.

programme.desc: برنامج أسبوعي منوع، تلتقي فيه منى الشاذلي بالناس بعيدًا عن زحام الأحداث اليومية وتوتر الأخبار المتلاحقة، لتنقل لهم حكايات حقيقية لم يشاهدوها أو يسمعوها من قبل الأبطال وشخصيات تستحق اﻹحترام. A weekly diverse talk show, where Mona Al Shazly meets with people away from the tension of daily news and events, to present her audience with original and genuine stories they have never heard of before, about people and heroes who deserve respect and admiration.(n)

programme.title: بيت مراد
programme.desc: برنامج يقدمه الكاتب والسيناريست أحمد مراد برفقة ابنته، يتناول فيه عددًا من أشهر الكتب والروايات، في حوارات خفيفة وشيّقة يوضح من خلالها أهمية القراءة ودورها في تشكيل الوعي والثقافة، وكيف كان لبعض المؤلفات المصرية تأثير واسع وصل إلى قراء حول العالم. ويستضيف البرنامج في مواسمه المختلفة عددًا من نجوم الفن. The show is hosted by writer and author Ahmed Mourad alongside his daughter. Together, they discuss a selection of famous books and novels in light and engaging conversations, highlighting the importance of reading, its role in shaping culture and awareness, and how Egyptian literature has reached readers around the world. The show also features guest appearances by renowned artists.(n)

programme.title: اللون الأزرق
programme.desc: تعود عائلة إلى أرض الوطن لتصطدم بواقع مرير، حيث تبدأ رحلة مضنية لعلاج ابنهم في مواجهة نظرات المجتمع الرافضة، بينما تعيش الأم صراعاً مريراً بين آلام الحاضر ومخاوفها القاتمة من المستقبل. A family returns to their homeland only to face a harsh reality, beginning a grueling journey to care for their son while confronting the disapproving eyes of society. Meanwhile, the mother struggles bitterly between the pains of the present and her dark fears for the future.
